newsitem.title: FRANCE: ONIC seen raising French 96 maize crop estimate.
newsitem.headline: ONIC seen raising French 96 maize crop estimate.

text.p: French cereals office ONIC is expected to raise its estimate for French maize output in 1996 to 14.212 million tonnes from a previous target of 13.997 million, industry sources said on Friday.
This would compare with a 1995 crop of 12.394 million tonnes.

The decision, which is included in a draft report ahead of its official publication next Wednesday, would bring the delivered crop at 12.3 million tonnes against 11.98 million forecast last month and 10.42 million delivered in the previous season.
ONIC is also expected to raise its forecast for the use of maize in animal feed to 2.6 million tonnes from a previous target of 2.3 million and 1.916 million in 1995/96.
It may raise its target for French maize exports to other European Union countries to 6.0 million tonnes from 5.92 million forecast last month and 6.087 million exported in 1995/96.
But it may cut exports to non-EU countries to 100,000 tonnes from a previous target of 200,000 tonnes and 164,000 tonnes last season.

The data suggest France would end the 1996/97 season with a maize carryover of 2.825 million tonnes against 2.827 million forecast last month and 1.647 million in 1995/96. --Paris newsroom +331 4221 5432
